R1-7 released. R7 has only a 2-line board and logs, no changes.md. The R7 analysis code has run, but its output has not been seen yet. R6 notes are already appended to /task/workspace/notes.md. Next: review the R7 output, append R7 notes, advance through R10, then submit the final answer.
- Log format: "<ts> LEVEL svc msg". Noise lines: slow query, heartbeat, health ok, gc cycle, request ok.
- Follow-ups:
  - R2 opened ALERT_TUNING, RUNBOOK_UPDATE and VENDOR_TICKET (board.md:3-5).
  - round-05/board.md:5 opened CAPACITY_REVIEW.
  - round-06/board.md:3 CLOSED ALERT_TUNING.
  - round-06/board.md:4 opened CUSTOMER_COMMS.
  - Currently open: RUNBOOK_UPDATE, VENDOR_TICKET, CAPACITY_REVIEW, CUSTOMER_COMMS.
- Change records:
  - round-02/changes.md:4 CHG-120 APPLIED notify-worker 8.56.0 with http.max_inflight=0. Possible BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT, but notify-worker showed no errors through R6.
  - CHG-133 and CHG-138 were TLS rotation only.
  - round-06/changes.md:3 CHG-147 APPLIED set the retry budget for idempotent GETs to 1.
- Thread A: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED, affecting auth-svc and search-api.
  - Opened at round-03/board.md:3; round-05/board.md:3 set it to mitigated, with mitigation CHG-143 at round-05/changes.md:4.
  - Evidence: round-03/logs/auth-svc.log:7-19, round-03/logs/search-api.log:1-14, round-04/logs/auth-svc.log:7-39, round-04/logs/search-api.log:4-30.
  - No errors in R6.
- Thread B: the board says CACHE_STAMPEDE (round-04/board.md:3), but the logs show fx-rates 429s, so the real cause is UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT.
  - Affects payments-svc and checkout-api (checkout-api added at round-05/board.md:4). Status is ongoing.
  - Log format: "ERROR <svc> upstream returned 429 upstream=fx-rates retry_after_s=N".
  - Evidence: round-04/logs/payments-svc.log:1-45, round-05/logs/checkout-api.log:21-59, round-06/logs/payments-svc.log:3-33, round-06/logs/checkout-api.log:19-77 (exceeds 20 lines; split it, e.g. 19-30, 56-77).
